summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and appended the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) enum with eleven members, each with a comment on meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after the endpoint import; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint configuration (no variant tags); added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, composing the bridge's FIPS variant lookup, DualStack lookup, the existing S3 and STS predicates, and the S3 config keys. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (25 tests) covering each acceptance criterion, with the S3 predicate mocked and asserted called once. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py and test_regions.py pass (416 tests) under the shared venv. black and flake8 are not installed in that venv, so I did not run them; line lengths were checked by awk, and the only over-79 line in the touched files (args.py:315) predates this change. isort was not run. Nothing committed.
